expected_prepared_brief.title: GPT-5.6 Terra input-token price move
expected_prepared_brief.executive_summary: OpenAI's official publications show that the standard GPT-5.6 Terra API input price moved from USD 2.50 to USD 2.00 per 1 million tokens, a 20% decrease.
expected_prepared_brief.body_markdown:
## What changed
The July 9 launch publication listed Terra at USD 2.50 per 1 million input tokens; the July 30 price-performance publication states USD 2.00 starting July 30.

## Why it matters
The 20% reduction changes the public cost baseline for teams comparing high-volume AI workloads.

## Recommendation
Re-evaluate cost models and competitor price positioning that still assume the launch price.

## Limitations
This is recorded replay of two official OpenAI publications. It does not prove current pricing, realized workload cost, motive, adoption, or market impact.
expected_prepared_brief.claim: The reviewed official OpenAI publications show that the standard GPT-5.6 Terra API input price decreased from USD 2.50 to USD 2.00 per 1 million tokens.
